# EvalStudio by HubForge

> Free browser-based creative tools for monitoring, evaluation, learning (MEL), research, technology and AI. Pick a template, personalise it with a live preview, and download.

EvalStudio is a creative studio, not an evaluation consulting service or a general-purpose AI chatbot. HubForge is its parent ecosystem. These public pages describe real working tools; no account is required.

## Studios
- [Sticker Lab](https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/sticker-lab/): Make personalised monitoring, evaluation and learning stickers. Choose from 32 original templates, edit your words and colours, then download PNG or SVG for free.
- [MEL Meme Maker](https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/meme-maker/): Create workplace-safe monitoring, evaluation and learning memes. Personalise 12 original compositions and download PNG or SVG images. No account needed.
- [Workshop Playbox](https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/workshop-playbox/): Make editable evaluation bingo, reflection prompts, voting cards and Theory of Change activities. Download A4 PNG or SVG pages, or print workshop materials.

## Practical details
- Editors require JavaScript. Their public studio guides do not.
- PNG and SVG downloads are generated in the browser.
- Workshop activities can be printed or saved as PDF through the browser print dialog.
- Personalised text, favourites and saved creations stay on the visitor's device.
- There is no required paid AI runtime service. The panda provides curated suggestions, not generative AI chat.
- Downloading or sharing an image does not install a WhatsApp sticker pack.
- My MEL Identity and Fieldwork Kit are not available editors.

## Sticker Lab

Small designs for the people asking big questions. Make stickers about research, evidence, fieldwork, responsible AI and learning together.

1. Choose one of 32 original designs in six collections.
2. Personalise the words, colours, typography and output format with a live preview.
3. Download a PNG or SVG. Save favourites and designs in My Collection on your device.

Use designs in presentations or share them as images. A downloaded image is not an automatically installed WhatsApp sticker pack.

Open the editor: https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/#/sticker-lab

## MEL Meme Maker

Humour from the situations evaluation teams recognise: late baselines, reporting deadlines and questions about what changed. Laugh together, not at the communities you work with.

1. Choose one of 12 original editable compositions.
2. Personalise the joke, colours and format with a live preview.
3. Download a square or landscape PNG, or an SVG. Explicitly saved designs stay in My Collection on your device.

Custom text is your responsibility. Keep jokes friendly, respectful and workplace-safe. This is a template editor, not an AI image or joke generator.

Open the editor: https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/#/meme-maker

## Workshop Playbox

Make evaluation workshops more participatory. Start with an activity, adapt it to your session and prepare useful materials for people to work with.

1. Choose evaluation bingo, assumption challenges, reflection prompts, voting cards, Theory of Change cards or retrospective sheets.
2. Edit the content for your group. Use facilitator guidance and choose low-ink settings when useful.
3. Download the current page as A4 PNG or SVG, or print the activity using your browser. Save as PDF through the print dialog.

A4 PNG pages are 2480 × 3508 pixels. For printing, choose A4, actual size and no margins, and disable browser headers and footers.

Open the editor: https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/#/workshop-playbox
